why: the frozen A10 strict set is only on the machine that produced it; an independent, human-verified public set was built instead

dataset.source: Open Images V7 test split (images CC BY 2.0, annotations CC BY 4.0)
rules: coverage = human-verified image-level label for the class (person: Person itself)
exclude images needing rotation or with group-of boxes of covered classes
per class: verified positive with at least one box; plus hard negatives
dataset.storage: images kept only in ignored dataset_pipeline/review_artifacts/; rebuild with the builder, seed and the list below
dataset.overlap_note: Open Images test split; A10 drew its Open Images images from its own train/val sampling, overlap not verifiable without A10 source lists

rule_simulation_at_0_7.decision: not adopted: both rules remove correct bicycle/bin boxes while false positives barely change

per_class_policy_simulation.decision: not applied to the App; product decision pending

findings: android preprocessing matches offline on independent photos; the legacy pipeline is not better here (earlier local PoC result did not generalise)
bin (P 1.00 at 0.7) and bicycle (P 0.92) are reliable; person precision 0.77 at 0.7 needs 0.8 for 0.87
door precision never exceeds about 0.69 and recall is 0.09 at 0.7
stairs recall is 0.04: the model almost never detects stairs in these photos, a safety-relevant gap thresholds cannot fix
